g.title: prose_dsp
g.text: Prose 2000 DSP (µPD7720, program v3.12): synthesizer topology, one sample every 100 µs (10 kHz)

Decompiled program: src/dsp/prose_synth.c (REFERENCE §13). [xxx] = program address. wN = word N of the 40-word frame the 8086 sends every 10 ms (§11.3). Resonator values are pole frequency / bandwidth.

g.title: fetch
g.text: raise USF0, pulse P0 → 8086 IRQ (8259 IR0)
no word: keep the frame once, then silence

g.title: pulse
g.text: rate = ROM[0x103 + type], fine ramp if type ≥ 15

g.title: glot
g.text: resonator, gain w37, coefficients w38 / w39

g.title: key
g.text: pitch-synchronous: latched at each period start
per voice (ESC[nV), sent in every frame
